system.description:
Wild Flame: Make an Interface Roll
against up to three adversaries within
Melee range. Targets you succeed
against take 2d6 techno damage and
must mark a Stress as a burst of flame,
plasma, or volatile chemical spray
erupts from your gear.
Utility Arm: You deploy a mechanical
hand, drone claw, or remote
manipulator with the same size and
strength as your own within Far range.
Smoke Field: Make an Interface Roll
(13) to deploy a temporary thick cloud
of smoke, fog, signal chaff, or
obscuring vapor that gathers ina
stationary area within Very Close
range. The fog heavily obscures this
area and everything in it.
